title: Launch Bridge Room Playbook (Draft)
content:
Purpose: quick, portable guide for whoever owns the launch bridge room during launch week. This is intentionally terse — a checklist + scripts + owners we can copy into the bridge room doc.

High-level goals:
- Keep the product online and high quality for the rollout window.
- Make go/no-go decisions within SLA timelines and escalate fast when needed.
- Capture actions, owners, and clear rollback triggers.

Bridge room setup (first 30m)
- Invite: release-engineering lead, SRE on-call, console PM, infra on-call, customer-success triage, build-release owner. Slack channel pinned. Zoom room link pinned.
- Start status board: live incidents, rollouts, model version, capacity, feature flags.
- Confirm monitoring dashboards visible to everyone (latency, error-rate, token throughput, GPU saturation).
- Confirm access: deploy console, feature-flag dashboard, K8s/VM console, upgrade/revert playbooks.

Pre-flight checklist (pre-launch, owners and quick checks)
- Canary had 2h of traffic with 0.5x expected load (owner: Ethan Chen) -> status: done
- Model artifact validated (hash + size) (owner: Sofia Ruiz) -> status: done
- DB migrations validated in staging and no blocking locks (owner: Liam O'Connor) -> status: pending (ETA 09:30)
- Autoscaling policy smoke test passed (owner: infra on-call) -> status: done
- Feature flags for launch gated behind release toggle (owner: console PM) -> status: done
- Alert runbooks reviewed and pinned to bridge channel (owner: SRE lead) -> status: done

Go / No-Go cadence and criteria
- Decision window: T-minus 15m, T-minus 5m, and immediate post-deploy check (T+10m).
- Go if: canaries show error-rate <= 0.5% and avg P50 latency < target for 15 continuous minutes, CPU/GPU headroom >= 20%, no blocking alerts.
- No-Go triggers: sustained error-rate spike > 1% for 5m, GPU OOMs, model mismatch checksum, DB migration locks, critical customer-facing bug triage level P0.
- If No-Go: immediate rollback to previous release (owner: build-release owner). Announce in channel and page product-EM.

Quick rollback script (play-by-play)
1) Pause new traffic via load-balancer toggle (owner: infra).
2) Revert the deployment to tagged release vX.Y.Z via CI/CD console (owner: build-release).
3) Unset feature flags introduced in this deploy (owner: console PM).
4) Validate system health (SRE) for 10m before full traffic restore.

Escalation ladder (who to page in order)
- SRE on-call -> SRE lead -> Platform Eng director -> CTO (if cross-region outage or >30m unresolved).
- Product-EM -> Head of Product for external comms if customer-impacting.

Communication template (copy into slack/zoom chat)
- Short update: "STATUS: [GO/NO-GO] — reason summary. Actions: 1) list 2) list. Owners: @name. ETA for next update: +10m."
- Customer comms draft for P0/P1 incidents (owner: customer-success): short problem summary, impacted surface, mitigation steps, ETA for next update.

Post-launch immediate follow-ups (first 2 hours)
- 10m health check (SRE): token throughput, latencies, error-rate, disk/I/O metrics.
- 30m user-facing symptom check (CS): top 5 customer tickets, any high-value customers impacted.
- 60m regression spot-checks (QA): 10 smoke prompts for model drift, structured outputs correctness.
- 120m cost review (infra): verify autoscaling didn't trigger unexpected spend.

Notes / gotchas (informal)
- If you see intermittent 502s tied to image-puller errors, there's a race in our startup script; warm nodes before rollout.
- Watch for increased KV cache misses during cold starts, that often transiently raises token costs — explain to product if it persists.
- Timezones: ensure APAC on-call is notified for late-window launches.

Action items (sprint-style list to convert to Jira)
- [ ] finish DB migration dry-run in staging (owner: Liam O'Connor) — due: 2026-03-06
- [ ] add canary traffic generator to infra playbooks (owner: Ethan Chen) — due: 2026-03-10
- [ ] run smoke prompt set for model v3.2 on private infra (owner: Sofia Ruiz) — due: 2026-03-07
- [ ] tidy rollback checklist and add CI playbook link (owner: Maya Patel) — due: 2026-03-09

Open questions to resolve before finalizing playbook
- Do we want automated rollback after 3 No-Go triggers in 30m or manual-only? pros/cons in channel.
- Who owns outbound customer comms for suspected model-quality regressions (PM or CS)?
- Should the bridge room include a dedicated notes scribe role for postmortem timelines?

Quick reference links (to pin in bridge channel)
- CI/CD revert guide: CONFLUENCE-RT-1847
- Canary generator script: github.com/redwood-inference/canary-runner (link in repo)
- Feature flag console: internal/feature-flag-dashboard

If you're covering the bridge for me: TL;DR - follow the pre-flight checklist, use the Go/No-Go criteria, make decisions fast and be conservative with rollouts. Capture all timestamps in the meeting notes and tag me if anything smells like a data migration or model checksum mismatch.

---
Hand-off notes (for next owner's quick scan)
- last canary window: 2026-03-04 16:15 UTC, metrics looked clean; small spike in cold-start latency for L0 nodes.
- current planned release tag: release-v2026-03-05-rc2
- key contacts: Ethan (canaries), Sofia (models), Liam (migrations), SRE lead (infra).

End of doc.
